generation.predicted_outcome: A reduction in sintering temperature by approximately 10-20% compared to traditional methods.

falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the machine learning-optimized sintering temperature does not result in a statistically significant reduction compared to traditional methods, the hypothesis is falsified.
